memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: This is the inheritance of the tribe of Judah, according to its clans: The southernmost towns of the tribe of Judah in the Negev toward the boundary of Edom were: Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur, Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah, Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan, Ziph, Telem, Bealoth, Hazor Hadattah, Kerioth Hezron (that is, Hazor), Amam, Shema, Moladah, Hazar Gaddah, Heshmon, Beth Pelet, Hazar Shual, Beersheba, Biziothiah, Baalah, Iyim, Ezem, Eltolad, Kesil, Hormah, Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah, Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain and Rimmon—all these towns and their villages - Josh 15:20-32 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Now comes a long roll of town names — dozens of them, listed one after another as the inheritance of Judah in the Negev. To us they are unfamiliar and hard to pronounce, and it is tempting to skip past them. But each name was a real place, a real community, a home for real families who would live, worship, and raise children there under God's care.

God did not hand Judah a vague region and leave them to sort out the details. He recorded town after town, making sure each was counted as part of the promised inheritance. This is the God of the specific and the particular. He does not deal only in grand sweeping promises; He attends to the individual places where His people actually live their ordinary lives.

Among these names sits Beersheba, where Abraham once called on the name of the Lord, and Ziklag, which would later shelter David in his wilderness years. Ordinary-sounding places carry the fingerprints of God's unfolding story. It reminds us that the ordinary places of our own lives — our streets, our homes, our workplaces — are not beneath God's notice. He is present and at work in the unremarkable towns of our days. The One who numbered Judah's villages numbers the details of your life and calls them His own.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you believe God is present and at work in the ordinary places of your life?
- How does God's attention to individual towns encourage you about your own daily setting?
- What "unremarkable" place in your life might God be quietly working through?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You that You attend to the ordinary places where I live my life. Help me to see Your hand at work even in the unremarkable corners of my days. Amen.
